guiPresentation.title: Feature/&PowerAttackPowerTitle
guiPresentation.description: Take a -3 to hit penalty to your attack for the rest of the turn to do +3 damage when you land your strikes. Only to be used when attacking with a one handed non-light weapon, melee or ranged.

guiPresentation.title: Feature/&PowerAttackTwoHandedPowerTitle
guiPresentation.description: Take a -3 to hit penalty to your attack for the rest of the turn to do +6 damage when you land your strikes.  Only to be used when attacking with two hands, melee or ranged.

guiPresentation.title: Feat/&PowerAttackFeatTitle
guiPresentation.description: You learned to trade accuracy to lander deadlier/harder blows.  You can choose to take a -3 penalty to your to hit in order to do more damage (+3 damage for one handed weapons, +6 damage for two handed weapons).  Lasts for the whole turn once activated.  Works with melee and ranged weapons.

guiPresentation.title: Feature/&PowerAttackTwoHandedAttackModifierTitle
guiPresentation.description: Take a -3 to hit penalty to your attack for the rest of the turn to do +6 damage when you land your strikes.  Only to be used when attacking with two hands, melee or ranged.

guiPresentation.title: Telema Unleashed
guiPresentation.description: This mini campaign allows you to play the Kickstarter Telema demo.
